title: Home
text: Design and development assets, ideas, and standards for AI, and their agents, tools, and harnesses.

title: Docs
text: Start here. What oinam.dev is, and how an agent should read it.

title: Standards
text: Linted, formatted, evaluated, tested, followed, and documented.

title: Writing style
text: Plain text, no emoji, and American English with the Oxford comma.

title: Components
text: Oinam UI: components in plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with no framework.

title: Install
text: Link the stylesheet and scripts, copy the files, or hand the guide to an agent.

title: Tokens
text: Colors, type, space, and shape. Two colors do all the work: ink and cloud.

title: Wrap
text: Centers the page content and keeps it off the edges.

title: Stack
text: A column. Children sit one under the other, a gap apart.

title: Row
text: A row that wraps. Children sit side by side, a gap apart.

title: Grid
text: Equal columns, as many as fit, with no breakpoints.

title: Text
text: A small label above a heading, and an opening paragraph a size up.

title: Prose
text: A run of writing. Plain headings, paragraphs, and lists get their rhythm.

title: Card
text: Groups related things on a raised surface.

title: Badge
text: A small label: a status, a count, a "new".

title: Alert
text: Sets a message apart: a note, a warning, or danger.

title: Table
text: Frames a plain table and lets a wide one scroll sideways.

title: Button
text: A button, on a <button> or an <a>.

title: Field
text: A label, its control, and a line of help, kept together.

title: Choice and switch
text: A checkbox, a radio button, or a switch, with its label.

title: Accordion
text: A set of <details> that open and close.

title: Tabs
text: Turns a run of sections into tabs.

title: Dialog
text: A modal, on a <dialog>, opened and closed without script.

title: Copy
text: Adds a copy button to a block of code.

title: Theme
text: A light and dark toggle that remembers the choice.

title: Example
text: Shows markup at work and prints its source beside it.

title: Components guide
text: The whole system as one page of plain text, for AI agents.

title: Play
text: Change the fonts, corners, and colors, watch every component follow, and take the variation away.

title: Garden
text: One page and many designs of it. Each is a few lines of tokens. Add yours.

title: llms.txt
text: A plain-text map of this site for language models.

title: AGENTS.md
text: The canonical instructions for any AI agent working in or pointed at the repository.

title: Source on GitHub
text: The repository. Open and free, under the MIT license.
